cases.description: Freeze world: the same Wish cast is refused (Freeze needs a unit), no wall ever stands, the walk is straight: the mirror must plan on the Welcome map exactly as today.
cases.name: freeze_world_no_wall

cases.description: A click past a standing wall: the server plans round it; the mirror's path must be the same.
cases.name: click_past_standing_wall

cases.description: A click on the wall's middle tile: the server snaps the goal off the ice and stops where it plans to.
cases.name: click_into_standing_wall

cases.description: The west key held (an order every 2 ticks, the 100 ms repeat) into a standing wall: each goal is the steering goal on the map with the wall LOW, and the walker stops against the ice.
cases.name: keyboard_into_standing_wall

cases.description: A walk under way when a wall lands across it: in the landing tick the server re-plans the blocked walk from where it stood to its last waypoint, and walks the new path that same tick.
cases.name: wall_rises_on_walk

cases.description: A detour planned round a wall that falls while it is walked: the server re-plans nothing when a wall falls, so the detour is walked to its end.
cases.name: wall_falls_mid_detour

cases.description: Orders applied on the tick before the expiry tick E, on E itself (inputs run before the wall falls: still planned round it) and on E + 1 (planned through the open tiles).
cases.name: orders_across_expiry

cases.description: A walker standing in a one-tile corridor when a wall lands on it, with no room on either side: the wall keeps a gap round it (rows 11..=13 are not ice). An order north is unreachable (the server stays); one south inside the gap is walked.
cases.name: gap_walker

cases.description: A walker on the wall's line when it lands: the server sets it down east of the ice (displace_seq + 1) and re-plans its walk; the mirror follows the correction and pushes nothing itself.
cases.name: pushed_walker

generator: cargo run -p rh-parity --bin frost-wall-walk-fixtures (crates/rh-parity/src/frost_wall_walk_goldens.rs); checked by crates/rh-parity/tests/frost_wall_walk_golden.rs
source: crates/rh-sim Sim::reset_active, SimConfig { abilities: Full, wish_lock_ms: 0, frost_wish, quests: false, consumables: false, hitboxes: Archetypes }, a Fire (hero) walker and a Frost caster, 20 Hz
timing: an order or cast with tick k is submitted before step k (the client issues it at 50 * (k - 1), after applying row k - 1); row k is the state after step k; each row's walls are the walker's own observation of that tick (the State frame the client applies before the row's self sample)
